+#summary One-sentence summary of this page.
+
+= Introduction =
+
+This page shows how to install tsDyn and compile it from sources.
+
+
+= Details =
+
+Currently, the version 0.6 is in the CRAN repository and hence easily
avalaible. For those who want nevertheless the newest functionnalities, you
will have to download and compile it yourself.
+
+=Get the source=
+This is very easy when you use subversion (you have to install it) and
allows you to have always the newest version. Just create an directory
called tsdyn:
+
+{{{mkdir tsdyn}}}
+
+go into it:
+
+{{{cd tsdyn}}}
+
+and dowload it:
+
+{{{svn checkout http://tsdyn.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/ tsdyn-read-only}}}
+
+No each time you want the new version just go in the directory and type:
+
+{{{svn update}}}
+
+=Compile it=
+Now you have the source package you will want to make it readable for R,
you have to go to the directory ({{{cd tsdyn}}}) and enter:
+
+{{{sudo R CMD INSTALL tsDyn}}}
+
+prompt your password and this will be done. You will have maybe some
dependency problems (tsDyn *depends* on mgcv, Matrix, minpack.lm, rgenoud,
*recquires* nnet, tseriesChaos, tseries, utils and *suggests*: tcltk, sm,
scatterplot3d, rgl).
+
+
+[Intro Back] to package description here.
